controls.label: Absolute temperature T (K)
controls.meaning: Temperature of the liquid; D is proportional to T.

controls.label: Dynamic viscosity eta (mPa*s)
controls.meaning: Viscosity of the liquid; D is inversely proportional to eta.

controls.label: Particle radius a (micrometres)
controls.meaning: Radius of the suspended sphere; D is inversely proportional to a.

controls.label: Elapsed time t (s)
controls.meaning: Observation time; MSD grows linearly and RMS grows as its square root.
